title: The Lot Where Time Pools

features.name: arrival stack
features.desc-on-touch: four vehicles parked in the same space at once: a 1970s Holden, a 1990s Corolla, a 2010s Prius, and one that hasn't been invented yet

features.name: temporal marker
features.desc-on-touch: where time gathers like oil on rain-wet asphalt; you see your own arrival here reflected at every hour of every day

features.name: decay registry
features.desc-on-touch: weathered directory cards listing every vehicle that ever parked here, with rust-through dates and next-arrival times

features.name: attendant's booth
features.desc-on-touch: a small structure where someone collects fees for the privilege of being parked at multiple times at once

features.name: chronological shadow
features.desc-on-touch: an impossible shadow cast by a car that's still arriving; it points in four directions at once

inscription: the lot where time arrives without taking anyone anywhere
